summary: Aircraft registration form — field layout and visual arrangement
description: The registration form must display aircraft identification fields in a two-column grid layout. Fields include Registration Number, Aircraft Type, Manufacturer, and Year of Manufacture.

acs.text: All four fields are displayed in a two-column grid layout on desktop viewport
Registration Number field is positioned in the top-left cell of the grid
The form renders without visual overflow at 1280×720 viewport

sections.content: Standard form layout for aircraft data entry. Two-column grid for primary identification fields.

Exact field placement, spacing, and column widths are defined in the prototype at https://www.figma.com/file/abc123XYZ/AircraftRegForm?node-id=12%3A45 — use this as the authoritative visual reference for layout validation.
